services.name: Aloha Charter - 4 Hour Private Charter
services.desc: About our Private Charters 4 hour private fishing charter on our 35ft Cabo sportfishing boat. Booking a private charter allows you to customize your fishing experience and fishing methods used. Weather permitting we can: Bottom fish for reef predators using a variety of methods from live bait, chunk bait, and artificial jigging. Troll for pelagic fish (tuna, mahi, wahoo, marlin) Combination of both methods Fishing License Required Hawai‘i has joined other ocean states in the country and now requires a license for recreational ocean fishing for non-Hawai‘i residents. The license is easy to get at the [Department of Land and Natural Resources-Division of Aquatic Resources (DLNR-DAR)
